A refined adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones and restrained highlights on clothing, keeping her own colours in soft, clean tints. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image. Both shoulders and upper arms show and run on past the edge — never an armless torso.

Time of day: late morning — clear fresh daylight, soft short shadows; morning light slanting through the window across the floor.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.

POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head turned back over her shoulder; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests low, below the frame edge — that arm runs down from her shoulder out of frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she blows a stream of bubbles through a bubble wand with a little bottle of soap; it is all she holds.

EXPRESSION: challenging eyes under lowered lids, one brow raised, mouth corner tugged in a slight smirk. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
